companyName: Illinois Wind Portfolio (Bright Stalk, Harvest Ridge)
rationale: EDPR sold and regulated Bright Stalk and Harvest Ridge as one 405 MW Illinois portfolio. Direct transaction evidence establishes an initial 68% close on July 1, 2021 and an additional 12% close on September 8, 2021, leaving unnamed Greencoat-managed investors with 80% and EDPR with 20%. Current manager and directory evidence supports continued ownership, while the exact acquisition fund and upstream holding companies are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical manager-level Illinois Wind Portfolio parent rather than separate Bright Stalk and Harvest Ridge PortCos.
Record unnamed Schroders Greencoat-managed investors as the 80% current owner and EDPR as the 20% current owner from September 8, 2021.
Preserve the July 1, 2021 initial 68% Greencoat-managed close and September 8, 2021 upsize as separate ownership milestones.
Treat Lexington Chenoa Wind Farm LLC and Broadlands Wind Farm LLC as child project SPVs and do not count them separately.
Do not invent a Greencoat fund, acquisition holdco or EDPR upstream holder.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact Greencoat fund and co-investor names
Exact common acquisition holdco and EDPR upstream holder
Whether a named common legal parent above both project SPVs exists
